text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! I shall take
good
care of these and use them to
decorate my room!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Won't they all take up a lot of space?

text_block_list.text:
Oh no, these are tiny compared to the
ones I
brought from home.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
In fact, this size would be easier to
snuggle up
with and fall asle—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you won these plushies for me,
so I shall
treasure them always!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
